background: BNP Paribas Fortis is the largest bank in Belgium and the Belgian retail and commercial arm of BNP Paribas, funded by Belgian deposits and lending to households, companies and the public sector, with Turkish and Luxembourg subsidiaries.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, with one placed on a negative outlook on 3 Nov 2026, a few months after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Liquidity is the weak spot, with LCR of 130% and NSFR of 109% both in the bottom quarter of EU and Nordic banks. Capital is mixed, CET1 of 13.5% in the bottom quarter but leverage of 7.1% in the top quarter. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has risen 0.7 points and leverage 0.4 points, with figures only to 31 Mar 2026.
